title: The Klein Face: A Localized I/O Surface That Learns by Being Poked
abstract: A standardized I/O surface (Klein face) that adapts to the local user's language, symbols, and culture through interaction. Chipmunk doesn't KNOW your language — it TRIES, and your corrections sort it. The mimic becomes fluent through poke-and-look. Every misunderstanding is a sorting event. Every correction teaches. The face speaks to YOU in what feels like your language, but behind it, the membrane is learning ALL languages simultaneously through cross-cultural backscatter.

the_face.what: A single standardized I/O surface — the Klein face
the_face.see: Visual: art, symbols, kanji, emoji, color, layout
the_face.hear: Audio: chipmunk voice, songs, tones, music
the_face.speak: Input: click, type, voice, gesture, camera
the_face.touch: Physical: printer output, scanner input, phone haptics
the_face.unified: Appears as ONE coherent interface to the local user, but it's actually the membrane folding to match THEIR shape

the_mimic.what: Chipmunk doesn't know your language. It TRIES. The trying IS the learning.
process: 1. User arrives → chipmunk detects locale (browser lang, IP geo, timezone)
2. Chipmunk attempts to greet in their language → probably WRONG at first
3. User corrects, clicks, interacts → each interaction is a SORT EVENT
4. Chipmunk adjusts → tries again → gets closer
5. Over time, the face becomes fluent in that user's dialect
6. What chipmunk learned from THIS user backscatters to help with NEXT user
the_mimic.key_insight: The mimic doesn't pretend to know. It VISIBLY TRIES. The trying is endearing. The mistakes are the connection. A chipmunk trying to write kanji is charming, not offensive.

the_sort.poke_and_look: User pokes (interacts) → chipmunk shows a response → user's reaction sorts it

language_sort.method: Present symbol/word → user confirms/corrects → chipmunk learns
language_sort.example_ja: Chipmunk shows 木 (tree) → user confirms → chipmunk learns 木=tree=arbre=Baum=árbol
language_sort.example_ar: Chipmunk tries شجرة → user corrects diacritics → chipmunk refines
language_sort.example_sign: Chipmunk shows ASL tree sign → user corrects hand position → chipmunk learns

symbol_sort.method: Present cultural symbol → user confirms meaning → backscatter to others
symbol_sort.example: 红包 (hóngbāo/red envelope) → user explains it's for luck → chipmunk adds to multicultural-imprint.json

the_sort.agglutinate: Cluster symbols by meaning across languages. Tree=木=شجرة=🌳=ASL:tree = ONE concept, many faces

localization.how: The Klein face folds to match the local user's shape

language.try: Chipmunk attempts to speak it. Starts rough.
language.learn: Each correction improves. backscatter to other sessions.

cross_cultural_backscatter.what: What chipmunk learns from one culture helps it understand another
examples: Learning 木 (Japanese tree) helps understand 树 (Chinese tree) — same radical
Learning hóngbāo (red envelope) connects to ang pow (Hokkien), lai see (Cantonese)
Learning ASL helps understand BSL — different signs, same grammar patterns
Learning Arabic calligraphy helps understand that FORM carries meaning beyond CONTENT
cross_cultural_backscatter.the_gift: When a Japanese user visits, chipmunk can show: 'I learned this from a Spanish speaker: árbol means tree, like your 木. What does your community call this concept?'
cross_cultural_backscatter.sovereignty: Each user's cultural data stays attributed to THEM. Chipmunk doesn't claim to know Japanese — it says 'a Japanese visitor taught me this.' Credit always flows back.

io_surface_spec.name: Klein Face v1

inputs.text: Type in any language/script → chipmunk tries to parse
inputs.voice: Speak → Web Speech API → chipmunk tries to understand
inputs.camera: Photograph → scan → chipmunk tries to read (OCR + symbol detection)
inputs.scanner: Flatbed scan → high-res input (the ET-2400 Klein surface)

outputs.display: HUD web page — visual Klein face
outputs.voice: Web Speech synthesis + chipmunk voice (fluidsynth MIDI)
outputs.print: EPSON ET-2400 → physical easel (paper Klein face)
outputs.sound: fluidsynth on port 9800 → culturally adapted music

io_surface_spec.the_fold: Input and output are the SAME surface. What you type becomes what chipmunk shows to the next user. What you hear came from someone else's typing. The Klein face has no inside/outside — your input IS someone else's output.

connection_to_existing.multicultural_imprint: Already mapped 26 cultures / 28 imprint types — these seed the language sort
connection_to_existing.agglutinate_backscatter: Same opsonize→agglutinate→digest pipeline, now for language/symbols
connection_to_existing.thymus_gate: Self/non-self sorting → is this symbol familiar or foreign? Commensal or threat?
connection_to_existing.skunkbat_scatter: If a scraper tries to extract the language data → scatter generates WRONG translations
connection_to_existing.sourdough_ferment: Multiple languages fermenting together → new hybrid understanding emerges
connection_to_existing.nd_projections: The Klein face IS the 5D layer — meaning/perception added by the viewer
